title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-08-01
lineage: source 1: SBD>MR>R>R>D>CD>EAC>SHN; source 2: SBD>MR>C>D>CD>EAC>SHN; source 3: AUD>MR>C>C>C>CD>EAC>SHN

ai_review.summary: A near‑perfect matrix recording captures a legendary 1973 birthday show highlighted by an epic Dark Star → El Paso → Eyes → Morning Dew sequence.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised for Jerry Garcia’s birthday fire, the soaring pre‑verse jam in Dark Star and the seamless flow into El Paso, Eyes and a transcendent Morning Dew.  Listeners note that the mix balances board clarity with just enough audience ambience to feel like you’re in the room, despite occasional early glitches and a muddy low end on the bass.  Overall the show is considered one of the era’s classics.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 4‑5 stars, emphasizing an outstanding musical performance; recording comments are largely positive with only a few minor complaints, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is praised as crisp and well‑balanced with board clarity plus audience ambience; early set has a few glitches, bass can sound muddy in places, and drums are slightly louder than usual.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers love the seamless transition Dark Star → El Paso → Eyes → Morning Dew and note that the second set carries the birthday energy, while the first set is described as solid but less memorable.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s birthday performance is repeatedly called “sizzling,” with perfect tone, a King Crimson tease, and an unstoppable groove throughout Dark Star.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil’s bass drives the pre‑verse jam in Dark Star; reviewers call his playing “top form” and highlight his melodic runs.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mixed remarks – some say Bob is “whacked,” but most do not comment negatively; overall his contribution isn’t highlighted as a flaw.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s fills are praised, especially in the chorus of Eyes; his touch is described as fantastic and complementary to the jam.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill Kreutzmann’s drumming is noted for being punchy, crisp, and at times louder than usual, adding energy without overwhelming the mix.
